auditor_note: Requested offset=999999; server silently clamped it to 100000 and echoed the CLAMPED value back in the 'offset' field as if it were the requested value, with no disclosure field indicating a clamp occurred. Confirmed with a second value (offset=500000) also clamping to exactly 100000 — see ganita_chart_facts_get__pagination_past_end_offset500000.json. Root cause pinned at platform/src/lib/retrieval/registry/layers/register_d7_channel.ts:924: `const offset = Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(args['offset'] ?? 0), 100_000))`.
